item.title: Docker Swarm to Kubernetes: migration strategies
item.description: Migrating from Docker Swarm to Kubernetes doesn’t happen over a weekend. Concept mapping, migration patterns, pitfalls to avoid and a concrete hands-on review of a production migration.

item.title: Contributing to open source: a Helm chart for transfer.sh
item.description: transfer.sh is a widely used command-line file-sharing tool, but it had no official Helm chart. I filled that gap with an open source contribution and opened a PR on the upstream repository.
